cards.visible_setting: Rain-speckled passenger-side windshield view of one right-hand-drive charcoal car already parked parallel to a quiet curb at blue-hour; a warm glow appears only through the passenger-side window.
cards.observable_action: The woman points through her side window while the man points forward in the opposite direction; one centrally mounted phone shows a bent blue route line and dot.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's right index finger points toward her side window and her left hand is below crop. Man's left index finger points forward and his right hand rests on the steering wheel.
cards.gaze: They cut their eyes toward each other with matching mildly exasperated expressions.
cards.body_blocking: Both upper bodies remain separately traceable in their seats, with the central phone between them.
cards.object_state: One active centrally mounted route phone; one parked car; no chai objects.
cards.camera_view: Frontal-oblique medium close view through the passenger-side portion of the windshield.
cards.visible_continuity: The car, rain, clothes, route phone and restaurant-side glow establish the evening.

cards.visible_setting: The same parked right-hand-drive car a few seconds later, with rain and restaurant glow visible only through the passenger-side window.
cards.observable_action: Both pointing hands have dropped. The woman looks out her side window while the man looks forward; the central phone shows a route leaving a dot, looping tightly and returning toward it.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's hands rest together on her lap. Man's right hand rests on the steering wheel and left hand lies open on his thigh.
cards.gaze: They look away from each other and do not blame or confront.
cards.body_blocking: The central phone and their turned-away profiles form one clear triangle; seats, dashboard and bodies remain separate.
cards.object_state: One active mounted phone; one red-fob key in ignition; car remains parked.
cards.visible_continuity: Same car, clothes, phone, weather and side-window restaurant glow as slide 1; hands have changed from pointing to withdrawn.

cards.visible_setting: Beside the same car parked on the quiet side of the divided road, near a low stone barrier.
cards.observable_action: The woman closes her passenger door, steps toward the barrier and raises one stop palm without turning. The man has begun to move around the rear of the car but freezes mid-step and lowers a dark phone.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's right palm is raised and her left hand owns her handbag strap. Man's left hand lowers one dark phone and his right hand hangs relaxed.
cards.gaze: Woman looks toward the barrier. Man's mouth closes and his attention stops on her gesture.
cards.body_blocking: Both complete silhouettes and the widening gap remain clear of the car body and closed door.
cards.object_state: Passenger door closed; phone screen dark; handbag on woman's shoulder; closed umbrella against car.
cards.visible_continuity: They have moved out of the same car; the active route phone from slide 2 is now dark.

cards.visible_setting: One long low stone barrier beside the parked car; restaurant glow remains across the divided road.
cards.observable_action: The woman sits at the far-left end facing the road. The man has sat at the far-right end several feet away with ankles crossed and both palms supported beside his hips.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's hands remain close to her body. Man's two open palms contact the barrier top beside his own hips; no phone is visible.
cards.gaze: Woman faces the road. Man looks toward the opposite side rather than watching her.
cards.body_blocking: A wide empty gap separates them; both seated silhouettes are fully distinct from the barrier and parked car.
cards.object_state: Phone fully hidden; car parked; umbrella closed; no chai objects emphasized.
cards.camera_view: Wide barrier-level side view dominated by distance.
cards.visible_continuity: The interrupted movement from slide 3 has changed into two settled seats at opposite ends of the same barrier.

cards.visible_setting: Same barrier and parked car; car rear-light and closed umbrella remain behind the man.
cards.observable_action: The woman keeps her body facing away but glances back once. The man remains seated at the far-right end exactly as before, gaze turned away.
cards.hands_and_contact: Man's two palms remain open on the barrier beside his hips; woman's hands are outside the crop.
cards.gaze: Woman checks behind her. Man deliberately looks elsewhere.
cards.body_blocking: Woman's foreground shoulder remains separate from the man's smaller full seated silhouette.
cards.object_state: Phone remains invisible; car and umbrella preserve location; no chai objects.
cards.visible_continuity: The man's seat, hands, crossed ankles and gaze match slide 4 while the woman's attention changes.

cards.visible_setting: Beside the same parked car, with one unlabelled roadside counter on the quiet-curb side and the restaurant across the road.
cards.observable_action: The woman has returned closer and points directly toward one steaming metal kettle on the counter. The man follows her pointing line and his shoulders loosen.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's right index finger points at the kettle and left hand owns her handbag strap. Both of the man's hands remain in his own pockets.
cards.gaze: Woman looks toward the counter; man looks at the kettle with a small relieved smile.
cards.body_blocking: The gap is half the width of slide 4. Both silhouettes, the pointing line, counter and car remain separate.
cards.object_state: One steaming kettle; exactly two empty stools; no chai poured; phone hidden; umbrella closed.
cards.camera_view: Low medium two-shot with a diagonal gesture-to-kettle sightline.
cards.visible_continuity: The woman closes distance; the man's phone stays absent; the roadside counter enters clearly for the first time.

cards.visible_setting: At the same unlabelled roadside counter; the two previously empty stools are occupied, with the parked car and restaurant glow behind.
cards.observable_action: The woman holds the single last biscuit slightly out of reach with a triumphant smile. The man reaches with one open palm and reacts with mock offense.
cards.hands_and_contact: Woman's left hand holds one chai glass and right hand holds one biscuit. Man's left hand holds one chai glass and right hand reaches empty. Exactly four hands. One empty paper sleeve lies untouched on the counter.
cards.gaze: They look at each other and the biscuit with playful, matched energy.
cards.body_blocking: They sit on separate stools angled inward; hands, glasses, biscuit, sleeve, counter and seated bodies remain separately traceable.
cards.object_state: Exactly two chai glasses, one biscuit, one empty unbranded sleeve and two occupied stools; phone remains absent.
cards.camera_view: Intimate low counter-level comic action-reaction two-shot.
cards.visible_continuity: The two empty stools from slide 6 are occupied; distance has contracted; practical irritation has changed into play.
